Implemented collapse_retval fixup: folds '__retval = expr; return __retval;' into 'return expr;' and drops the slot decl when the slot is assigned exactly once immediately before the return and mentioned nowhere else. Added fuse_zero_init fixup: folds 'let mut x: T = 0; x = expr;' into 'let mut x: T = expr;' when the store is the immediately following line and does not read x. add.c now initializes c directly from a+b. Implemented compound_assign fixup: rewrites 'a = a <op> rhs' -> 'a <op>= rhs' for simple local slots with pure rhs. Added Stmt::CompoundAssign to Rust AST. Verified with cargo fmt + cargo nextest r --release (136 passed).

Lowered the cir.libc.mem* family (memcpy/memmove/memset/memchr) to byte-wise std::ptr ops + __slate_memchr helper; added PtrCopy/WriteBytes AST nodes and 4 differential fixtures. Plain libc mem* calls already worked via extern; only clang builtins/aggregate bit_cast raise these ops. Idiom-recognizer is a no-op stub upstream (noted in emit.rs).

Added call_args rust_ast fixup: inlines single-use temps into (a) declared param slots of non-variadic callees and (b) call-result temps into any slot (incl. vararg) when no side effect sits between def and use. Vararg bare-literal hazard stays blocked. add.c now emits add(2,3)/add(-10,4)/add(0,0) with results handed directly to printf. 4 unit tests + differential shape assertion; cargo fmt + nextest (141) green.

Implemented conservative retval fixup for main exit boilerplate in src/fixups/retval.rs, added differential output-shape coverage, and verified with cargo fmt, cargo test, and cargo nextest r --release.

Added drop_call_results fixup: drops the binding of a synthetic _vN temp that holds an unused call result, rewriting 'let _v = <call>;' to a bare '<call>;' (preserving unsafe wrappers and arg evaluation). Only call-bearing inits are touched; used results and pure unused temps are left alone. Unusedness checked per lexical scope incl. block tails. compound_assignments/add.c now emit 'unsafe { printf(...) };'. 4 unit tests + differential shape assertion; integrated with slate-04q.5 (retval sig change) at merge; cargo fmt + nextest (149) green.

Rendered control-flow conditions (if/let-if/match/expr-if/expr-match) bare instead of at PREC_CALL, matching Stmt::While; the precedence-aware renderer already emitted minimal arithmetic/bitwise/shift parens so no AST paren node existed to strip. Added redundant_parens.c fixture + assertion test.

Implemented remove_mut fixup over Rust AST bindings: removes mut from params/locals without later mutation, preserves mut for assignments, address-taking, mutable borrows, array mutable pointers, atomics, and method receivers. Added unit and differential shape coverage. Verified with cargo fmt, cargo test, stdlib_coverage, generated_differential, and cargo nextest r --release.

Implemented AST printf format recovery for constant formats with plain text, %%, and one or more %d conversions; all-or-nothing per program to avoid mixed stdout buffering; removes printf extern when fully rewritten. Verified with cargo fmt and cargo nextest r --release.

Extended printf macro recovery to %i, %u, %ld, %lu, %lld, %llu, and %zu constant integer formats with exact argument counts. Added unit and differential output-shape coverage. Verified with cargo fmt and cargo nextest r --release.

Implemented conservative static integer printf width/flag recovery for zero padding, left alignment, plus signs, and static widths; rejects dynamic widths, precision, space/# flags, and ambiguous combinations. Added unit tests plus printf_integer_widths differential fixture. Verified cargo fmt in the ticket worktree and cargo nextest r --release on main; main cargo fmt --check is currently blocked by unrelated dirty preprocessor edits.

Added preprocessing oracle (src/preprocess.rs) recording #if/#ifdef/#ifndef/#elif/#else/#endif regions with normalized predicates, directive/body source ranges, mapped Rust cfgs, and active/inactive state resolved against Clang's predefined macros. Unknown predicates are kept opaque + diagnosed, not guessed. Exposed via 'record-cfg' JSON command; recorded cfgs match tests/fixtures.cfg/expected_cfgs.json. Existing single-config/translate-cfg behavior unchanged. Verified with cargo nextest r --release (183 tests).

Implemented conservative printf %s/%c macro recovery for direct constant UTF-8 C strings and constant ASCII character values, with local constant tracking and rejection of pointer strings, interior-NUL strings, and non-ASCII character bytes. Added unit tests plus supported/rejected differential fixtures. Verified with cargo fmt and cargo nextest r --release on main.

Implemented fixed-decimal printf macro recovery for %f and %.Nf in src/fixups/printf_format.rs, with supported and rejected fixtures. Verified with cargo fmt and cargo nextest r --release on main (187 passed).

Rewrote translate-cfg to derive the whole-item cfg matrix from the lq0.2 preprocessing oracle instead of a filename table: each recorded branch -> a variant with clang args pinning every chain macro, rust_cfg from the recorded predicate mapping, validated against the oracle to activate exactly its branch. OS/arch/NDEBUG fixture output is unchanged. Refuses with diagnostics: fragment cuts inside a function/record body (brace-depth scan), predicates without a known cfg mapping, and >1 top-level chain (nested/sibling deferred). No-conditional sources pass through to single-config lowering (unchanged). Known limitation: negated/ifndef opening branches are validation-refused rather than merged (candidate uses a define-atoms heuristic); multi/nested chains deferred per epic scope. Added reject fixtures + tests. Verified cargo nextest r --release (195 tests) and cargo fmt.
emit-fixtures now renders tests/fixtures.cfg/*.c through translate-cfg into git-ignored tests/fixtures.cfg.generated/*.rs (reject/ skipped) for side-by-side C/Rust comparison.

Added docs/cfg-portability.md: single-config vs multi-config semantics, the supported predicate->cfg table (_WIN32/__linux__/__APPLE__/x86_64/aarch64/arm/NDEBUG), user macro configs via SLATE_CLANG_ARGS + record-cfg, and refusal cases. Linked from CLAUDE.md and cfg fixtures README.

Implemented printf %x/%X/%o macro recovery in src/fixups/printf_format.rs, including static width, zero padding, and left alignment forms. Added printf_hex_octal fixture and differential output-shape assertions. Verified with cargo fmt and cargo nextest r --release on main (196 passed).

Added rust_ast::Cfg (Flag/Opt/Not/Any/All) + Item::Cfg wrapper, rendered by codegen. preprocess::pred_to_cfg now builds Cfg values (Branch.rust_cfg: Option<Cfg>); cfg_translate merges/gates whole rust_ast Items via item_key, dropping all text-splitting. #[cfg(...)] now emitted from the AST, not a formatted string. Output byte-for-byte unchanged; 196 tests pass.

Implemented exact printf alternate integer prefix recovery for %#x, %#X, and %#o in src/fixups/printf_format.rs, including zero-value handling and static width/zero/left alignment via single-evaluation format! block arguments. Added printf_alternate_integer fixture and differential output-shape assertions. Verified with cargo fmt and cargo nextest r --release on main (197 passed).

Implemented conservative printf %p recovery in src/fixups/printf_format.rs with pointer-typed argument checks, supported/rejected fixtures, and output-shape assertions. Verified with cargo test --test differential -- --nocapture and cargo nextest r --release.

Structured preprocess diagnostics distinguish unmapped-macro (unknown project macro, named + flagged uncovered when inactive) from opaque-predicate shapes; record-cfg emits {kind,line,message}; docs updated. Merged to main.

Implemented project macro cfg(feature) mapping, per-region translate-cfg planning for multiple and nested whole-item chains with a 16-variant cap, docs, and cfg fixtures. Verified with cargo fmt and cargo nextest r --release.

Dispatch-loop break mismatch fixed: value-returning functions emit unreachable!() at the wildcard so the loop diverges and coerces to the return type; verified in isolation and on regenerated libyaml crate (no E0308 dispatch errors).
Implemented AST string_lift fixup with structural &str/&[u8] Rust AST types, conservative raw-pointer safety checks, and differential coverage. Verified with cargo fmt and cargo nextest r --release.

Fixed in inline_temps fixup: single_safe_use ignored the enclosing block's yielded tail (LetIf then_value/else_value, unsafe block tail), so a temp used once in the body and once in the yielded value was wrongly inlined, dangling the tail reference (E0425 _vN). Threaded tails into the use analysis; temps feeding a tail keep their binding. Verified on regenerated libyaml crate: 0 missing-value errors (was _v279 in scanner.rs). Added fixture assign_value_in_branch.c + unit test; 219 tests pass.

Implemented a post-string-lift AST fixup for strlen/strcmp/strncmp/memcmp on lifted &str/&[u8] operands, with conservative interdependent lifting and differential coverage. Verified with cargo fmt and cargo nextest r --release.

Fixed stale extern cleanup for the string_libc fixup: rewritten strlen/strcmp/strncmp/memcmp declarations are now pruned when no raw calls remain, while surviving raw calls keep their externs. Verified generated fixture output plus cargo fmt and cargo nextest r --release.

Emit typedef'd anonymous records (yaml_string_t) via typedef-name adoption in c_ast, and function-local anonymous structs (anon.N STACK/QUEUE locals) synthesized from CIR type-alias layout + get_member field names, emitted per-module. libyaml crate 'cannot find type' errors: 58 -> 0. Remaining crate errors are unrelated signedness/field mismatches.

Adjusted lifted strlen rewrites to keep Rust's native usize result: generated temps now use usize and assign s.len() directly instead of u64 plus as u64. Verified fixture output plus cargo fmt and cargo nextest r --release.

Built a typedef table from Clang AST TypedefDecl nodes; parse_c_type resolves pointer/array-to-typedef base names through it before substring inference. yaml_char_t* now maps to *mut u8 matching CIR. libyaml crate E0308: 3956 -> 501 (remainder are i32/u32 enum mismatches = q0g.6). Fixture tests/fixtures/typedef_ptr_signedness.c guards the regression. Merged to main; 222/222 tests pass.

Implemented a string_copy AST fixup for safe local char buffers, rewriting unused strcpy/strncpy/strcat/strncat to String to_owned/push_str forms with truncating n-variant coverage. Verified with cargo fmt && cargo nextest r --release.

Added src/fixups/support/walk.rs read-only AST traversal helpers, migrated existing fixup walkers and string_copy boilerplate to use them, and documented the helpers in docs/writing-a-fixup.md. Verified with cargo fmt && cargo nextest r --release.

collect_records dropped the recursion (continue) after naming an anonymous record, so nested anonymous records (yaml_event_s.data.alias/.tag structs, node data variants) were emitted empty and field accesses hit E0609. Fall through to recurse. libyaml crate E0609: 333->0 (also E0308 74->40 from downstream). Fixture nested_anon_struct_fields.c guards it; 227/227 pass. Merged to main.
Added override-style expr/stmt fixup AST walkers in src/fixups/support/walk.rs, documented them, and verified with cargo fmt && cargo nextest r --release.

Member/element access with a bare raw-pointer-value base (e.g. (*p).f) computed unsafe_access without accounting for the base deref, so stores '(*p).f = x' and 'addr_of_mut!((*p).f)' args were emitted outside unsafe -> E0133. Mark unsafe_access when base is dereferenced (place_expr None) and wrap addr-of in unsafe when unsafe. libyaml crate E0133: 1864->0. Fixture ptr_member_store_unsafe.c guards it; 232/232 pass. Merged to main.

Implemented ptr_len fact collection for full-array pointer/length callsites and unsupported callsites, then rewrote signatures and calls from recorded facts. Verified with cargo fmt and cargo nextest r --release.
Added phase-local slice pointer view, index range, and pointer offset facts for lifted slice bodies. Verified with cargo fmt and cargo nextest r --release.

Added phase-local counted slice loop facts for canonical 0..slice.len() loops, including slice binding, induction variable, bounds, unit step, index-use constraints, and read-only vs mutable body access. Verified with cargo fmt and cargo nextest r --release.

Implemented def-use facts in src/fixups/def_use.rs with path-aware definitions, reads, writes, last-use tracking, scoped shadowing, branches, loops, and block tails. Verified with cargo fmt && cargo nextest r --release.

Implemented control-flow summary facts in src/fixups/control_flow.rs and wired them into facts::analyze. Verified with cargo fmt && cargo nextest r --release from main.

Implemented cast and coercion fact gathering in src/fixups/casts.rs, wired it into facts::analyze, and covered scalar, pointer, ref/slice, literal inference, ABI-pinned, variadic, and semantic rejection cases. Verified with cargo fmt && cargo nextest r --release from the worktree and main.
